mods.name: image-view
mods.author: jarrodwatts
mods.description: See the images you paste into Claude Code: thumbnails above the prompt instead of bare [Image #1] tags

mods.name: last-prompt-title
mods.author: zhangbububu
mods.description: Session titles that follow your latest prompt: cut for the CLI, written by Haiku for the desktop sidebar

mods.name: cc-zh
mods.author: jiangnanquan
mods.description: Simplified Chinese UI localization via static dictionary: slash-command descriptions, /config labels, spinner, hints, notices, command output, tool summaries and turn duration. Zero tokens / network; verified on CC 2.1.296

mods.name: subagent-tuner
mods.author: Kruhlikau
mods.description: Picks the model and effort of every subagent: a Manual/Auto band, a pick pane, review → Opus and search → Haiku, and a saved default that overrides what the agent asked for

mods.name: mod-store
mods.author: hellosverre
mods.description: An app store in a pane: /mods browses, searches and installs about 2,700 community mods, with what each one can access shown before you install. Or ask Claude to find one

mods.name: cache-meter
mods.author: T-AI-Labs
mods.description: The share of each turn the prompt cache served, next to the context fill, with an auto-compact threshold and Compact and Clear buttons

mods.name: usage-limits
mods.author: T-AI-Labs
mods.description: 5-hour and weekly plan limits in percent, with the time left until each resets

mods.name: pixel-pulse
mods.author: air01aditya
mods.description: A purple pixel strip above the prompt that drifts right to left and glows under the pointer, and a purple pixel spiral in place of the working spinner. Desktop app only; it only draws

mods.name: open-paths
mods.author: kiankhooban
mods.description: Click a file path in Claude's reply and the file opens in its app: Word, Preview or Excel for documents, your editor at the line for app.py:42, Finder for folders. Launchers, scripts and unknown types are never opened

mods.name: workflow-conductor
mods.author: bruw
mods.description: Terminal UI for planning, running and understanding complex agent workflows inside Claude Code: define the workflow as a graph, have Claude script and run it, and watch the run on the same graph. Needs Claude Code 2.1.296+ and a terminal 110+ columns wide

mods.name: bedrock-meter
mods.author: weidu-tpvision
mods.description: Token and USD meter for Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock: session cost, context fill, cache hit rate and today's total above the prompt, priced at AWS's own on-demand rates (refreshed weekly from the AWS price list), with a per-model breakdown in /bedrock-cost

mods.name: brainrot-break
mods.author: BordyV
mods.description: A TikTok-style feed of 350+ pixel art mini-videos in a pane while Claude answers: scroll, like, pick your themes, and an end card when Claude is done. Every video is a small simulation drawn locally: no tokens, no model calls. Terminal and desktop app, in 6 languages

mods.name: review-inbox
mods.author: SummerRiversound
mods.description: Your GitHub review queue above the prompt: PRs waiting for your review, your PRs that need something and issues that mention you, a one-sentence summary of each review request, and Review to put the chosen PRs into the prompt. Needs gh logged in

mods.name: cc-esol
mods.author: rapha-rodrigues
mods.description: An English coach for non-native speakers: Claude logs a native rewrite of each English prompt you type or dictate, with the reasons, to a local learning log you read and review in a pane. A Voice button toggles Claude Code's dictation
